user.title: Set up Euskotren Topo
user.description: Add the Topo journey planner to the sidebar. No account or API key is required.

data_description.default_origin: The planner selects this station when it opens.

abort.unavailable: The Euskotren timetable is temporarily unavailable.

get_train_positions.name: Estimate Topo train positions
get_train_positions.description: Estimate the positions of active trains along the railway using published timetables and trip predictions.

list_stations.name: List Topo stations
list_stations.description: Return station IDs, coordinates and the dates covered by the timetable.

search_journeys.name: Search Topo journeys
search_journeys.description: Return departures, arrivals, durations and stops. Use station IDs from List Topo stations.

origin.name: Origin
origin.description: Station ID of the departure station. If omitted, the integration uses its default origin.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: Station ID of the arrival station.

date.name: Travel date
date.description: Departures on this date. Defaults to today.

time.name: Earliest departure
time.description: Time in Europe/Madrid. Defaults to now for today or midnight for other dates.

limit.name: Results
limit.description: Maximum number of journeys to return.

not_loaded.message: Set up Euskotren Topo and wait for it to load.

unavailable.message: The Euskotren timetable is temporarily unavailable.

origin_required.message: Specify an origin or choose a default origin station in Euskotren Topo.

unknown_station.message: Choose a station from the published Topo timetable.
